summary: Iteration 6: email verification / resend / forgot / reset password (backend + UI), blast engine (8 neighbours), landing disclaimer + contact links, FR/EN/ES language cycle, SEO (titles, robots, sitemap, gtag, meta/OG/JSON-LD), sandbox blast, regression of rooms/sandbox. All requested features work. Backend 78/78 pytest pass (12 new auth tests + 66 regression). The iter4 rooms test helper had to be updated because new accounts now need email confirmation before login. No console or page errors on any flow tested.

minor.issue: No brute-force lockout: 7 wrong passwords in a row all return 401, then the correct password returns 200 straight away (playbook item 4 not implemented).
find_one then update_one is not atomic, so 2 concurrent requests with the same token could both succeed. Use find_one_and_update({hash, kind, used:false, expires_at>now}, {$set:{used:true}}).
JWTs issued before a password reset stay valid for 7 days (no token version / password_changed_at check).
Body lang is sent by the frontend but ignored (only forgot-password applies lang); the user.lang stored at register is used instead.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' together with allow_credentials=True in preview. OK because auth uses a Bearer header, but prod must set explicit origins (render.yaml/.env.example already do).

ui_bugs.issue: Description still says 'Salons temps réel (bientôt)' although online rooms are live. Stale text.

integration_issues.issue: resend() has no try/catch, so a network error gives an unhandled promise rejection and no error toast.

issues: The sonner success toast at top-right covers the header username/logout area for a few seconds

action_items: (Optional, security) Add login brute-force lockout (e.g. 5 failures per email+IP leads to a 15 min lock)
Wrap resend() in CheckEmail/Login with try/catch plus an error toast
Update the Home multiplayer card text (remove '(bientôt)' / 'soon' / 'pronto')
(Optional) Invalidate existing JWTs after a password reset
critical_code_review_comments: Tokens are stored as sha256 hashes, single-use, with a TTL index and a 60s cooldown per user+kind. Good design.
Forgot/resend never reveal whether an account exists. Register still returns 'Email already registered' (enumeration is possible there, which is acceptable).
seed_admin only inserts when missing and never overwrites the password (OK). Passwords are bcrypt $2b$ (OK). Auth is Bearer/localStorage, not httpOnly cookies (by design per test_credentials.md).
GameCanvas.jsx is 765 lines (>700). Consider splitting the effects (blueBlast, explosion, beamLine) into a separate module.
sitemap.xml, robots.txt and canonical hardcode https://robostrike.app. Fine for prod, but needs updating if the domain changes.
requirements.txt has no emergentintegrations, so the Render build should work. vercel.json SPA rewrite excludes robots/sitemap correctly.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_rooms_iter4.py (login helper now confirms email via the backend log link)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0 (xdist is on by default; test_robostrike.py's _last_link takes the globally newest link, which could race in parallel). Get tokens with: grep -a 'email to <email> not sent' /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log. landing-enter only renders when logged in (use landing-register when logged out). The browser's default navigator language is en, so set localStorage rs_lang first. Verified in the UI: register -> check-email -> resend toast; unverified login -> unverified-notice; forgot -> forgot-sent; verify-email bad -> invalid message; verify-email good -> /home logged in; reset -> /login -> login with the new password; per-route titles in FR/EN/ES; html lang and rs_lang persist across reload; Spanish 'Entrar en la arena', 'Acciones disponibles', 'Avanzar'; nav-contact/landing-contact/disclaimer-email/game-contact/room-contact are all mailto:Q.levasseur@epmistes.net. Sandbox: 6x blast for R1, resolve returns 6 blast beams, no console errors. The blue halo was not clearly captured in a screenshot (short fade window), but the blueBlast code draws a 3x3 halo.
